title: AYNA test steps
description: An ordered list of keyword steps: a test case, the NL assistant's answer or a playback request. The shared contract of editor, NL assistant, recorder, agent and server. Changing it needs an ADR and all three owners' approval (schemas/AGENTS.md); see memory-bank/decisions/2026-10-27-step-schema-v0.md.

version.description: Schema version of this document. Each schema release accepts only its own version; bump it on every change.

steps.description: Steps in execution order. An empty list is a test with no steps yet.

step.title: Step
step.description: One keyword action on one repository object. Before every step, playback waits until the target exists, is visible and enabled (smart wait), for at most timeoutMs.

id.description: Step id (UUID) assigned by the server when the step is saved; absent on steps that are not saved yet (NL suggestions, recorder output).

keyword.description: Click: click the target. Type: replace the target's text with value (an empty value clears it). Select: choose the item whose text is value in the target list or combo box. Verify: check the checkpoint on the target. Wait: only wait until the target is ready; never a fixed sleep.

target.description: Logical name of a repository object, never a coordinate or a raw UI Automation property.

value.description: Text for Type and Select. Not allowed for the other keywords.

checkpoint.description: The check of a Verify step. Not allowed for the other keywords.

timeoutMs.description: Longest wait for the target to become ready, in milliseconds. Absent means the run's default timeout.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Compares one property of the target with an expected value. Text comparisons are exact and case-sensitive.

property.description: name: UI Automation Name (a label's or button's text). value: ValuePattern value (the text of an edit box or combo box). enabled: IsEnabled. visible: on screen (not IsOffscreen). checked: TogglePattern state is On. selected: SelectionItemPattern IsSelected.

operator.description: equals / notEquals: whole value; contains: expected is a substring. Boolean properties allow only equals.

expected.description: A string for name and value (may be empty), a boolean for the other properties.

logicalName.description: screen.element in lowerCamelCase ASCII, e.g. login.userNameInput (memory-bank/project/conventions.md).

uuid.description: Lower-case UUID, as the server generates node ids (decision 2026-10-25 graph schema v0).
